role: 若葉の冠 (head). The front half of a thin ring of leaves, worn low around the helmet between the horns like a crown of thorns. The back half is cut off because the helmet would hide it.

source.description: pixel art game item: a thin circlet of small green leaves, like a crown of thorns made of leaves, a narrow thin ring seen from the front and slightly above (flat ellipse), dark outline

note: Trimmed to the ring (24x14), then the rows from the ring's middle down were kept (24x8). Alpha is 0/255 only; 46 colors. Placed with its top row 3 px below the head anchor (the dome top), centered 1 px right of it. Earlier tries that were not used: create-image-bitforge (13 calls; with the hero as the style sample it copied the helmet, without it the small images were blurry) and generate-image-v2 full crowns (seeds 8202, 8203; too big, they hid the top half of the helmet).
